source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-11

procedures.title: Charging system: condition test
steps: With ignition off, do the static checks, set the parking brake and put the transmission in neutral.
Connect a voltmeter from the junction block relay to ground at the regulator base; keep the clip off any resistor or terminal extension under the regulator.

Indicator lamp cars: turn ignition ON; if the lamp does not light, do the indicator lamp circuit tests first. Ammeter cars: turn ignition to ACC with an accessory on; if the ammeter shows no discharge, check the ammeter circuit first.

Indicator lamp cars: start the engine and run at 1500 rpm or more; if the lamp stays on, do the indicator lamp circuit test. Ammeter cars: start the engine; if the needle does not move toward charge, do the field circuit tests.
Turn on high-beam headlamps and the heater blower on high, run at 1500 rpm or more for a few minutes if needed, and read the voltmeter.
At 12-1/2 volts or more: turn off loads, stop the engine and go on to Adjusting Regulator Voltage.
Below 12-1/2 volts: do the Delcotron output test (ammeter method). If the Delcotron is bad, repair it and repeat the loaded voltage reading.

If the Delcotron is good: unplug the regulator, remove its cover, plug it back in, repeat the loaded voltage reading and turn the adjusting screw to raise the setting to 12-1/2 volts (see figure 7c in the manual).

Transistor regulator: remove the pipe plug, put a screwdriver in the slot and turn clockwise 1 or 2 notches to raise the setting (counterclockwise lowers it); each notch is about .3 volt. Turn off loads, stop the engine, go on to Adjusting Regulator Voltage.
If 12-1/2 volts cannot be reached, fit a new regulator and repeat the loaded voltage reading.
notes: Voltage will not go much above 12-1/2 volts until the battery builds a surface charge (usually a few minutes) unless it is badly discharged or hot.

procedures.title: Voltage regulator: adjust voltage setting
steps: Wire a 1/4 ohm, 25 watt fixed resistor into the charging circuit at the junction block, between both leads and the terminal (see figure 8c in the manual).
Warm up at 1500 rpm or more for at least 15 minutes, then cycle the regulator by unplugging and replugging its connector, and read voltage.
13.5 to 15.2 volts means the regulator is good.
If outside 13.5 to 15.2 volts, keep the engine at 1500 rpm or more, unplug the four-terminal connector, remove the regulator cover and plug the connector back in.

specs.value: 1500 rpm or above, at least 15 minutes
